coverage: Pending · FMZ rotating futures account adapter

Official Binance checksums cover all 51 exact USD-M markets around the October 2022 source revision. The isolated native engine omits Binance Info fields and the unchanged source changes pairs without rebinding each futures contract. The 2026 benchmark also lacks three archived symbols. A verified account/contract adapter and full aligned input files remain necessary.

market_archive.scope: Official monthly checksum bodies verified. File-size, full bar continuity, funding and mark/index payloads were outside this metadata probe.

source_dependency_proof.native_init: The parent initializes two exchange objects with SetContractType(swap) and reads account.Info.totalMarginBalance. The data-access library subsequently switches each scanner product through SetCurrency without resetting contract type.
source_dependency_proof.rotation: The business library computes the largest absolute lookback return from all 51 products and opens the selected perpetual. Its input lookback defaults to 168; the bar period comes from the exchange object.
source_dependency_proof.raw_venue_state: The linked data-access functions consume BUSD and USDT asset rows in account.Info and market-specific position.Info fields such as mark, margin, and liquidation data.

native_control.scope: Isolated fixture on two public 15-minute USD-M feeds. A synthetic order exercised the sandbox only. This is an adapter capability test with no strategy metrics.
